MiniCraft - a from-scratch Minecraft-style voxel game (Windows x64)
===================================================================

HOW TO RUN
  Double-click minicraft.exe.
  Keep the "assets" folder next to the .exe (it holds the shaders).
  No installation or extra DLLs are required (Windows 10/11 x64).
  A "world.sav" file is created next to the .exe to save your world.

CONTROLS
  W A S D ............ move
  Mouse .............. look
  Space .............. jump / swim up / fly up
  Left Shift ......... sneak / fly down
  Left Ctrl .......... sprint
  Double-tap Space ... toggle flight (Creative mode)
  Left mouse ......... break block
  Right mouse ........ place block
  Mouse wheel / 1-9 .. select hotbar slot
  G .................. cycle game mode (Survival / Creative / Spectator)
  F3 ................. debug info (shown in the window title bar)
  F5 ................. first / third person camera
  F2 ................. save a screenshot (PNG, next to the .exe)
  F11 ................ toggle fullscreen
  R .................. respawn (when dead)
  Esc ................ pause / release the mouse cursor

Status, FPS, position and game mode are shown in the window title bar.

Built from source with MinGW-w64 (statically linked GLFW + GLEW).
